v.q: What should the Jenkins controller NOT do?
v.w: Builds belong on agents. Zero executors on the controller keeps heavy or untrusted code away from it.

v.q: What is an executor in Jenkins?
o: A build slot on an agent
A plugin that runs shell scripts
v.w: An agent with four executors can run four builds at the same time.

v.q: Which is the recommended Jenkinsfile style?
v.w: Declarative has a fixed structure that Jenkins validates before running. script blocks cover rare cases.

v.q: Which section runs actions whatever the result of the build?
v.w: post conditions such as always, failure and cleanup run after the stage or pipeline.

v.q: What does a multibranch pipeline do?
o: A pipeline per branch and pull request
Runs one build on every agent
v.w: It scans the repository and builds each branch that has a Jenkinsfile, then removes it when the branch is deleted.

v.q: How does a pull request build block a bad merge?
o: A status check that must be green
An email is sent to all admins
v.w: Jenkins reports the result to the Git server, and the protection rule can require it to be green.

v.q: Why prefer a webhook to polling the repository?
o: Builds start at once with no polling
v.w: The Git server tells Jenkins about a change, so there is no delay and no repeated checking.

v.q: Which option stops two builds of one branch from running together?
v.w: It makes a branch run one build at a time, which protects deploy stages.

v.q: How should a Jenkinsfile use a registry password?
o: A line in the repository README
v.w: The secret stays in the credentials store, and the Jenkinsfile only names its id.

v.q: Why use single quotes around a secret in an sh step?
o: It hides the step in the UI
v.w: A double-quoted string puts the secret into the command line and process list. The shell should read the variable instead.

v.q: What is the main risk of a shared library?
o: A bug breaks every pipeline at once
It runs only on the controller
It needs a new Jenkinsfile format
v.w: A fix reaches every service, and so does a mistake. Pin a version such as @v3 and test changes.

v.q: Where does a shared library live?
v.w: Jenkinsfiles load it with @Library and call steps from its vars directory.

v.q: What is the benefit of a pod per build?
o: Every build starts clean and capacity scales
v.w: The pod is created for the build and deleted afterwards, so there is no agent to maintain.

v.q: Which tool builds images in a pod without a Docker daemon?
v.w: Kaniko builds from a Dockerfile with no daemon and no privileged mode.

v.q: Why keep the list of plugins small?
o: Each plugin is a dependency with its own risks
v.w: Every plugin adds code, vulnerabilities and upgrade risk, so install only what you use and keep it updated.

v.q: What is Jenkins Configuration as Code for?
o: Rebuilding the controller from a file
Encrypting the build logs on disk
v.w: The controller settings live in YAML in Git, so a lost controller can be rebuilt and changes are reviewed.
